statement: If as many even numbers as we please be added together, the whole is even.
heath_proof: For let as many even numbers as we please, AB, BC, CD, DE, be added together; I say that the whole AE is even. For, since each of the numbers AB, BC, CD, DE is even, it has a half part; [VII. Def. 6] so that the whole AE also has a half part. But an even number is that which is divisible into two equal parts; therefore AE is even.
ai_proof_text:
9.21
**Statement:** If as many even numbers as we please be added together, the whole is even.

**Step 1.** Let AB, BC, CD be as many even numbers as we please. We are to show that the whole, namely AD (the sum AB + BC + CD), is even.

**Step 2.** Since AB is even, by definition it is divisible into two equal parts [D7.6]. Let AB be divided into the two equal halves AE and EB, so that AE equals EB and AE + EB = AB.

**Step 3.** Since BC is even, by definition it is divisible into two equal parts [D7.6]. Let BC be divided into the two equal halves BF and FC, so that BF equals FC and BF + FC = BC.

**Step 4.** Since CD is even, by definition it is divisible into two equal parts [D7.6]. Let CD be divided into the two equal halves CG and GD, so that CG equals GD and CG + GD = CD.

**Step 5.** Now AE equals EB, BF equals FC, and CG equals GD. Adding equals to equals, AE + BF + CG equals EB + FC + GD [CN2].

**Step 6.** But AE + EB + BF + FC + CG + GD constitutes the whole AD (since AE + EB = AB, BF + FC = BC, CG + GD = CD, and AB + BC + CD = AD). Therefore AD equals (AE + BF + CG) + (EB + FC + GD), which is twice the quantity (AE + BF + CG), since AE + BF + CG equals EB + FC + GD.

**Step 7.** Therefore the whole AD is divisible into two equal parts, namely (AE + BF + CG) and (EB + FC + GD). Hence by definition AD is even [D7.6].

**Step 8.** The argument extends to any number of even summands by the same reasoning: each even number contributes equal halves, and summing the respective halves yields two equal parts of the whole.

**Step 9.** Therefore, if as many even numbers as we please be added together, the whole is even. Q.E.D.
